reason: A continuous function has closed inverse images of closed sets.
text:
Since \(\{0\}\) is closed in \(\mathbb R\) and \(f:X\to\mathbb R\) is continuous, the inverse image \(f^{-1}(\{0\})\) is closed in \(X\). Moreover,
\[
f^{-1}(\{0\})=\{p\in X:f(p)=0\}=Z(f).
\]
Therefore \(Z(f)\) is closed.
